source: Existing live browser Page.screencastFrame recordings supplied by the parent audit task.

encoding.timing: Variable frame rate at a 1/1000000 second time base. Every recorded frame is preserved in timestamp order.
encoding.scaling: 2560x1440 to 1280x720 with Lanczos; full-range JPEG converted to limited-range yuv420p.
encoding.start: Time zero is the first available frame. The small gap between recording start and the first frame is omitted because no image was captured then.
encoding.end: Last captured frame is held until the recorded end time. An identical terminal frame makes this hold explicit and adds one microsecond to the file duration.
encoding.overlays: None. No cursor, click marks, captions, reconstructed screens, cuts, speed changes or audio were added.

verification.full_decode: Passed without decoder errors, preserving the source time base.
verification.representative_frames: Decoded first and last frames of both recordings and three intermediate before frames were visually inspected. Form labels and entered audit text remain readable at 1280 pixels.

superseded_capture: The earlier ten-frame partial capture and scale-affected screenshot are archived outside the app, labelled superseded. Their duplicates were removed from the final audit folder after preservation checks.
